key: KXCOMPTROLLER|Will Terrell Miller be elected to be NYC Comptroller in 2025?|If Terrell Miller is elected to Comptroller in New York City in 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
reasoning: Terrell Miller was not elected NYC Comptroller in 2025. Mark Levine won both the Democratic primary (June 24, 2025) and the general election (November 4, 2025) decisively. While Miller did open a campaign account, he was not a major contender in the race, having raised only $60 as of mid-July 2024. The resolution criteria clearly states the market resolves YES only if Terrell Miller is elected; since he was not elected, the market resolves NO.
